tools.name: get_signing_guide
tools.description: The exact steps to turn a quote into a sent trade on the network it starts on, and how to follow it afterwards: what to approve, what to sign, in which order, and which of txHash and id get_trade_status needs. Give the quote's fromChainId. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_trade_status
tools.description: Where a sent trade stands: PENDING, DONE (with what was paid and received; for a bridge, once paid on the destination), REFUNDED (paid back on the source network; when refundBox is set, the refund waits in the user's own refund box: anyone may call its release(token) to send it to them), FAILED, NOT

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote · Private data: get_networks, get_api_info, get_quote, get_signing_guide, get_trade_status · Public sink: get_networks, get_trade_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote · Private data: get_networks, get_api_info, get_quote, get_signing_guide, get_trade_status · Public sink: get_networks, get_trade_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
